author: gogojedi
body: TheTNTPotato, In the video with the evidence regarding my ban, it just showed me normally killing and shooting people, If I was using force field, I would have turned to my team mates and tried hitting them to, as I did not do that in the provided video, Also, I used my bow to shoot people and I got some, Most people that I have seen using force field, just go directly to you, I am pretty angered because I have not ban evaded what so ever! I'm sorry for the late reply I had to go to Soccer classes, Hope fully this report will make you realize and help you understand the doings of force field, and how I was NOT using it. Thank you.
